become_litter.description: True will generate a 2-5 litter of kittens rather than a single cat. This means the abbreviation for this litter should not be used within the text of the event, since they have no singular name or pronoun
become_litter.title: Become Litter

assign_blood_parent.description: List of designations for cats who will become this cat's blood parents. These cats must have already been specified prior in involved_cats
assign_blood_parent.title: Assign Blood Parent

assign_adoptive_parent.description: List of designations for cats who will become this cat's adoptive parents. These cats must have already been specified prior in involved_cats
assign_adoptive_parent.title: Assign Adoptive Parent

assign_mate.description: List of designations for cats who will become this cat's mates. These cats must have already been specified prior in involved_cats
assign_mate.title: Assign Mate

prior_abbreviation.description: Specifies s_c choices. Read the docs. It's too long for this.
prior_abbreviation.title: Prior Abbreviation

can_create_new_cat.description: Add if the outsider/other_clan cat can be newly generated rather than having to utilize an existing cat. Can even be added as an empty dict to simply mark it as a new cat creation without any additional specifications
can_create_new_cat.title: Can Create New Cat

status.description: Constrains the event to only happen if the cat holds a certain role. You can utilize exclusionary tags. You can also remove the parameter to allow the event to occur for all roles except "newborns", who are only allowed if specifically tagged as such.
status.title: Status

past_status.description: Constrains the event to only happen if the cat held a certain role in the past
past_status.title: Past Status

age.description: Constrains the event to only occur if the cat is within a certain age group. You can also remove the parameter to allow the event to occur for all ages except "newborns", who are only allowed if specifically tagged as such
age.title: Age

gender.description: Constrains the event to only occur if the cat has a certain birth gender. can_birth will allow either female or male cats dependant upon the player's settings
gender.title: Gender

group.description: Constraints the thought to only happen if the cat is a member of a listed group or a member of no group. This should only be used to dictate what group a new cat is originally part of
group.title: Group

standing.description: Constrains the event to only happen if the cat matches with the dictated group standings. A group standing is the relationship between a cat and a group, for example: if they are an exile or lost
standing.title: Standing

stat.description: Constrains the event to only occur if the cat holds specific skills or traits. You can utilize exclusionary tags
stat.title: Stat

current_exp.description: Constrains the event to only occur if the cat has a listed experience level
current_exp.title: Current Exp

health.description: Constrains the event to only occur if the cat's health matches the constraints
health.title: Health

backstory.description: Constrains the event to only occur if the cat has a listed backstory. To find what each backstory describes, you can find more by going to resources/lang/en/cat/backstories.en.json. You can utilize exclusionary tags
backstory.title: Backstory

location.description: Constrains the event to only occur if a player chooses a specific biome.

season.description: Constrains the event to only occur once the Clan is in a specific season.
season.title: Season

strings.description: List of the text that will be displayed in-game as events.
strings.title: Strings

required_reputation.description: Constrains the event to only occur if the player clan has the required reputation
required_reputation.title: Required Reputation

relationship_constraint.description: Used to require specific relationships between the cats
relationship_constraint.title: Relationship Constraint

other_clan_temperament.description: Constrains the event to only occur if the involved other Clan has one of these temperaments.
other_clan_temperament.title: Other Clan Temperament

relationship_changes.description: Used to change specific relationships between the cats
relationship_changes.title: Relationship Changes

supply.description: Indicates changes to the supply of the Clan. Each supply change block is a new change
supply.title: Supply

death.description: Indicate which cats should die as a result of this event. You can specify different "types" of death as separate blocks
death.title: Death

condition.description: Indicate which cats should receive conditions and what conditions they receive. You can add multiple condition blocks
condition.title: Condition

lost.description: Indicate which cats should be lost from their Clan. You can add multiple lost blocks
lost.title: Lost

join.description: Indicate which cats will join the player Clan. You can add multiple join blocks
join.title: Join

future_event.description: Schedules another event to happen in the future.
future_event.title: Future Event

event_id.description: Separates the events into their blocks. Generally, the ID is descriptive of the cats included in the event or the general themes of the event.
event_id.title: Event Id

involved_cats.description: Used to add constraints for the various involved cats.
involved_cats.title: Involved Cats

cats.description: List of cats who will receive these conditions. patrol_cats can be used to give the condition to the entire patrol
cats.title: Cats

no_results.description: Set to True if there should be no result text about this condition application
no_results.title: No Results

non_lethal.description: Set to True to prevent this condition from killing the cat. It's not necessary if the condition is already non-lethal (eg. scrapes)
non_lethal.title: Non Lethal

condition.description: List of possible conditions. One condition will be chosen from this list. You can also utilize Injury Pools
condition.title: Condition

scar_pool_override.description: Override the default scars given for the assigned condition. Instead, a scar will be chosen from this list
scar_pool_override.title: Scar Pool Override

scar_history.description: String to be added to the cat's history if the condition creates a scar. Use m_c in place of the dead cat's name and pronoun
scar_history.title: Scar History

death_history.description: String to be added to the cat's history if the condition kills them. Use m_c in place of the dead cat's name and pronoun
death_history.title: Death History

cats.description: List of cats who will die. patrol_cats can be used to kill the entire patrol
cats.title: Cats

body.description: True if the body can be retrieved, False if the body has been lost
body.title: Body

history.description: String to add to the cat's death history. Use m_c in place of the dead cat's name and pronoun
history.title: History

no_results.description: Set to True to prevent this condition from killing the cat. It's not necessary if the condition is already non-lethal (eg. scrapes)
no_results.title: No Results

age.description: List of ages the cat can be. If they can be anything, use "any".
age.title: Age

status.description: List of statuses the cat can be. If they can be anything, use "any".
status.title: Status

skill.description: The cat must possess at least one skill from this list. If they can be anything, use "any".
skill.title: Skill

trait.description: The cat must possess at least one trait from this list. If they can be anything, use "any".
trait.title: Trait

gender.description: The cat will have this gender.
gender.title: Gender

event_type.description: Specify which ShortEvent type the future event will be.

moon_delay.description: How many moons must pass before the first event appears (inclusive). The first value is the smallest possible delay and the second value is the largest.
moon_delay.title: Moon Delay

pool.description: Pool of events to be chosen from. Only one event from the pool will be chosen.

involved_cats.description: Specifies which cats can fill the roles within the future event.

m_c.description: m_c in the future event. Can either be a cat in the current event or constraints for a newly chosen cat.
m_c.title: Main Cat

mur_c.description: The murdered cat in the future event. Can either be a cat in the current event or constraints for a newly chosen cat.
mur_c.title: Murdered Cat

r_c.description: r_c in the future event. Can either be a cat in the current event or constraints for a newly chosen cat.
r_c.title: Random Cat

sub_type.description: Events to be added to the pool will contain all subtypes specified.
sub_type.title: Sub Type

event_id.description: Only events with the specified event_ids will be added to the pool.
event_id.title: Event Id

excluded_event_id.description: All events with the specified event_ids will be removed from the pool.
excluded_event_id.title: Excluded Event Id

working.description: By default, this is always set to true. if set to false, the cat can't be a working cat (aka, they are currently disabled by a condition of some kind)
working.title: Working

condition.description: A list of conditions that the cat must have at least one of. if any condition is allowed, use "any"
condition.title: Condition

must_be_congenital.description: By default, this is always set to false. if set to true, the cat must have been born with a permanent condition listed in the condition
must_be_congenital.title: Must Be Congenital

must_be_acquired.description: By default, this is always set to false. if set to true, the cat must have acquired a permanent condition listed in condition later in life
must_be_acquired.title: Must Be Acquired

cats.description: List of cats who will join
cats.title: Cats

change_name.description: True if the cat should take on a more Clan-like name
change_name.title: Change Name

new_status.description: A list of possible ranks for the cat to take within the Clan. If left blank, the cat will take on a rank appropriate for their age
new_status.title: New Status

current.description: If True, cat must currently have mentor/apprentice. If False, cat must not have a current mentor/apprentice
current.title: Current

former.description: If True, cat must have a former mentor/apprentice. If False, cat must have a former mentor/apprentice
former.title: Former

has_suffix.description: If True, cat must have a suffix. If False, cat must have no suffix
has_suffix.title: Has Suffix

cats_from.description: The cat's whose relationship values are being edited. You are changing how the "cats_from" feels.
cats_from.title: Cats From

cats_to.description: The target of the relationship. You are changing how "cats_from" feels about "cats_to".
cats_to.title: Cats To

mutual.description: Controls if the relation effect will be applied in both directions.
mutual.title: Mutual

values.description: Controls which relationship values are affected.
values.title: Values

amount.description: Exact amount the relationship value will be affected. Can be positive or negative.
amount.title: Amount

log.description: The string that will display within the relationship logs. A string can be specified for both the cats_from and cats_to groups
log.title: Log

cats_from.description: The cat from whom the relationship originates.
cats_from.title: Cats From

mutual.description: Controls if the relationship is required in both directions
mutual.title: Mutual

constraints.description: Controls which relationship constraints are required
constraints.title: Constraints

group.description: the group we are checking the cat's standing with. you can utilize exclusionary tags. tags can be mixed and matched as necessary. if multiple tags are used, the cat will only need to qualify against one of the groups. You should not try to tag no_group
group.title: Group

currently.description: the standing the cat should currently possess with this group. tags can be mixed and matched as necessary. if multiple tags are used, the cat will only need to have one of the standings
currently.title: Currently

past.description: standings the cat used to have with this group. tags can be mixed and matched as necessary. if multiple tags are used, the cat will only need to have had one of the standings
past.title: Past

must_have_both.description: if set to true, the cat's trait AND skills must BOTH qualify. Otherwise, the cat must have either/or a listed trait or a listed skill
must_have_both.title: Must Have Both

trigger.description: If the Clan's current level of the specified supply type should be at a certain threshold for this outcome to occur, specify it here. You do NOT have to specify a trigger
trigger.title: Trigger

adjust.description: Keep in mind that this increase is "per" cat on the patrol. A 3 cat patrol being given an increase_medium will take home 3 times as much as a similar 1 cat patrol
adjust.title: Adjust

Temperament.description: Temperaments a Clan or patrol can hold. A "-" prefix excludes it.
Temperament.title: Temperament
